## Insure the Class

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
You run a phone insurance company. A claim costs **$600**.

::: {.incremental}
- Every customer is the same: roll a die, and **a 1 means a claim** (a 1 in 6 chance).
- Each team secretly sets a **premium**. Customers go to the cheapest insurer.
- Roll for each customer, then tally your profit and loss.
:::
:::
::: {.column width="30%"}
![](images/qr-dice.png){.qr .qr-small fig-alt="QR code linking to the on-screen dice page"}
[No die? Scan to roll on your phone]{.caption-line}
:::
::::

::: {.keyphrase .fragment .zoom-in}
What premium should you charge? Write it down now: no changing later!
:::
